title: Kestrel GAP Waiver Claim Intake Standard
content:
# Kestrel GAP Waiver Claim Intake Standard

## 1. Who may file

A claim is filed only on a waiver whose status is active. This applies both to filing the claim and to receiving its claim documents. The status is read from the company's waiver record for the same waiver the claim is filed on; a borrower's statement about the waiver does not establish it.

## 2. Filing deadline

The claim is filed within the claim notice days after the loss date. The loss date is day 0 and days are calendar days; the claim is in time when the filing date is not later than the loss date plus the claim notice days. Filing on the last day of the period is in time.

## 3. Theft

A theft is treated as a loss only when the vehicle has not been recovered within the theft recovery wait days. A theft claim needs a police report.

## 4. Documents

Every required claim document must arrive within the claim documents due days after filing, counted in calendar days from the filing date. Whether a document has arrived is judged from the claim documents on file: the document types received for the waiver from the claim filing date up to the moment the question is asked. Proof of the primary deductible is needed only for the deductible coverage.

## 5. One loss per waiver

Only one loss is claimed per waiver.

## Periods by level

| Level | Claim notice days after the loss date | Claim documents due days after filing |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel GAP Essential | 90 | 120 |
| Kestrel GAP Standard | 90 | 120 |
| Kestrel GAP Plus | 90 | 120 |
| Kestrel GAP Premier | 90 | 120 |
| Kestrel GAP Premier Plus | 90 | 120 |
| Kestrel GAP Max | 90 | 120 |

## Boundary cases (abstract dates)

| Case | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Claim filed on day 90 after the loss date | Within the 90 claim notice days |
| Claim filed on day 91 after the loss date | After the 90 claim notice days |
| A required document received on day 120 after the filing date | Within the 120 claim documents due days |
| A required document received on day 121 after the filing date | After the 120 claim documents due days |
| Claim on a waiver whose status is terminated, cancelled, expired or claim settled | Not filed — the waiver is not active |

## Points of judgement

- **Clock start.** The filing clock starts at the loss date; the documents clock starts at the filing date.
- **Documents on file.** Documents received before the filing date are outside the window that is counted.
